name: ielts-writing-ai
description: IELTS Writing AI - Full Stack Application

scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff check .
scripts.format: npm run format:backend && npm run format:frontend
scripts.format:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff format .
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:makemigrations: cd backend && uv run alembic revision --autogenerate
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && uv run python -m app.initial_data
